name: settings-profile
title: Settings: profile
description: Profile settings on a three-hole-punched page: photo upload with size and type checks, name, username (with a taken-name rule), email, bio with a live counter, pronouns, time zone, website and a search switch. vee-validate and zod, every message written under its field, and an index card that shows how others see you as you type. It is a sheet of paper, so it looks right on paper or on the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Settings: profile" block into your components directory under blocks/settings-profile/.
Import it: import SettingsProfile from "<your components alias>/blocks/settings-profile/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
